study_design.split_unit: whole dataset (a dataset has exactly one role); attack incidents are namespaced <dataset>:<attack_id> and therefore can never cross a train / validation / test boundary. Inside every dataset the first 14 days (20 for the legacy dataset) are attack-free onboarding.
study_design.note: sealed datasets' labels and incident registries are unreadable (eval_ml4.xfer.Vault) until the frozen config is hashed
